subject: Startups
title: Annual Recurring Revenue
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Annual Recurring Revenue.

hook.text: ARR is MRR multiplied by twelve. It's the number investors use to value SaaS companies at scale.

buildup.text: A company at $10M ARR is usually worth 10–30x that amount, depending on growth rate and market conditions.

discovery.text: The 'triple triple double double' framework says: triple ARR twice, then double it twice to reach $100M.

twist.text: ARR can hide seasonal spikes. A company that earned half its revenue in December looks stable but isn't.

climax.text: True ARR only counts committed, recurring contracts. Inflating ARR with one-time deals is a cardinal sin.

punchline.text: ARR is MRR's big brother—and investors love it.
